evidence.description: Spec 061 execution of record (Phase-423, 2026-10-21): gates 0.1-0.4 PASS, gate 0.3 reproduced the recorded Arm A summary digit-for-digit (median 0.00878393455594817, interval [0.004626892186724407, 0.01297407559730989], share 0.6231155778894473); gate 0.5 FAILED - A(1) = -0.0025188916876574316, A(1.5) = A(2) = A(3) = 1.0 exactly; closed CANNOT BE RUN AS WRITTEN; T* undefined on that record; the record itself names the generated-worlds repair direction.

Spec 028 calibration of record (SHA-256 4198747b...): Arm A positive control at frozen boost 3.0 over per-draw regenerated worlds - median adjusted R2 0.023963353007570576, interval [0.01564561395032637, 0.03362727672588614], rejection share 1.0; negative control median 0.0004562417889948378. The generated-worlds quantity the repaired calibration is levelled to.

The demonstration scores nothing on the real corpus.
